wiki.title: Steve Roberts (Missouri politician)
wiki.extract: Steven Roberts (born 1988/1989) is an American politician. He is a member of the Missouri Senate from the 5th district, serving since 2020. He previously represented the 77th district in the Missouri House of Representatives from 2017 to 2021. He is a member of the Democratic Party.
